Wing Hei Stop is a station of SLT Line 2905, Line 2915 and Line 2915P. It is located at Los Sengas Asylum. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 3129 (Evergold North Stop).

Wings Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is located at the northernmost area of West Metropolis Archipelago near Odyssey.

Before Odyssey was established as a district, the swamp area to the north which is now named Nightmare Marsh was named by Peckern Transit (Then Peckern Metro) developers as Wings Peninsula, and plans were in place to set up Two Stations for Southern Loop there. Hence, this isle is named Wings Isle.

This isle is an undeveloped area.

Fun Facts[]

Winsol is one of the Main Districts of Los Sengas. It is represented by pink-magenta, and became District Number 30 on January 8 2021.

History[]

When Nazca Railway extended Glacier Line northwards, the Los Sengas Government has named the four other districts within the Ingress Continent, one of which being Winsol, which did not see any Railway Development until Season 4, Episode 6 (S4E6). The name of this District can be traced back to the naming of Winter Point Gateway. Nazca Railway had plans to build three "Super-Checkpoints" between the end of Season 2 and Early Season 3, with one of them being located within Ingress Continent. Subsequent plans for Group 2 Gateways had seen the northeasterly Gateway coinciding with the location of the planned "Super-Checkpoint" at Ingress Continent, and hence the plans for Winter Point Gateway was formed. The "Winter" part of "Winsol" also ha its origins from that station.

However, four years after Winsol was named, neither Nazca Railway nor the Co-Op Railways had managed to set foot within this district, and only Route 3 passed through the middle of this district as a path between Asylum and Ingress, with no exits in between. Subsequently, Nazca Railway announced plans for the Ingress Continent in the 2024 Plans, and had even stated that Winter Point Gateway would be built in S4E6, and with the developer of Asylum having the willingness to develop Winsol in order to provide job opportunities for northeast Los Sengas residents and provide better connections, approval was granted in order to diversify Los Sengas Developement. Nonetheless, as Winter Point Gateway was not yet in use, Development has yet to commence except for the Asylum extension part.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Brumal Mirror.
  • This Station features three soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".
  • Ad Axem Hiemis is a Ballad that is specifically written for this station, complete with Lyrics written in Latin.

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is one of the Group 2 Gateways of Nazca Railway, and is located at approximately 20 km to the northeast of Metropolis Terminal.[3]

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 3100th page of this wiki.
  • All Group 2 Gateways make use of a shape at the sides of its walls. This Station uses Ovals.
  • Among all Group 2 Gateways, this Station is the furthest from Metropolis Terminal.[4]
  • Among all Group 2 Gateways, this Station is the first station to have lines defined for all platforms.[5]
  • The Exits in this Station are arranged in a counterclockwise fashion.
  • The Staircases leading to the Platforms from the West Concourse feature Building Materials that are characteristic of the platforms of the respective lines that the staircases will lead to. Notably, the upper layer of the Building Materials of the Staircase leading to platforms 5-8 have Snowty Line Building Materials to the South and Asylum Line Building Materials to the North. This signifies that Platform 6 is to the north of Platform 7 on the upper level. Similarly, the lower layer of the Building Materials of the same Staircase have Asylum Line Building Materials to the North and Snowty Line Building Materials to the South. This signifies that Platform 8 is to the north of Platform 5 on the lower level.
  • Asylum Line and Snowty Line has Cross-Platform Interchange in this Station. This also marks the first time where such a feature is implemented in Gateways[6].
  • This station, alongside Nightcord Station and West Hill Station, are all interchange stations of Asylum Line and Snowty Line. This is the third set[7] of "Triplet Interchanges" in Nazca Railway, with the first two sets being Hartasy Line, Wardring Line and West Ring Line, Luxter Line respectively[8]. However, unlike the previous sets, which adopted the standard rule of having one station for same direction, opposite direction, and inter-floor interchanges, this set of triplet interchanges had two stations that are of opposite directions[9] and one station with the same direction being West Hill Station.

History[]

  • September 25 2025: This station began construction.
  • September 29 2025: This station completed construction.
  • September 30 2025: This station began services alongside Ingress Line and Charlie Line, but Asylum Line, Snowty Line, Rover Line and Mike Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • November 12 2025: Rover Line extends from Amongus Lake Station to this station through Little Ramp Station.
  • January 13 2026: This station completed setting up Snowty Line and Mike Line systems.
  • January 14 2026: Snowty Line extends from West Hill Station to this station.
  • January 15 2026: Mike Line extends from Magma Line Station to this station.

title: Wisely South Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Wisely South Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Phoenix Line. It is located between Wisely Station and Flask North Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support the train flow needed for Phoenix Line, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to eight 9-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have four sidings each, which can store eight trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to Phoenix Line, with access to Wisely Station Platform 1 to the north and connections to Flask North Station to the south.

Fun Facts[]

This Stabling Siding is located underground, and is the second instance of Nazca Railway constructing an underground stabling siding since Intus Occident Stabling Sidings.

Gallery[]

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was originally named The Suicide Edge Station during the planning stages, as Ni Kuang had perished on July 3 2022, shortly before the beginning of S3E18, the name of this station has been modified to allude to a Science Fiction Series of the Same Name that was written by Ni Kuang.
  • The Wisely South Stabling Sidings is located to the South of Platform 1.
  • The Platform Layout of this station is identical to that of Mong Kok East Station of the MTR in Hong Kong with the regards that there are two platforms for trains in the Up direction and only one platform for trains in the Down direction.

History[]

  • August 6 2022: This station completed construction.[2]
  • August 7 2022: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was originally named Jawai Village Station, but was later changed to the current name. However, Twenty Village Station is later built between this station and Java Beach Station to pay tributes to that station name.
  • The new name of this station alludes to a former administrator who left this server due to historical reasons. The name of Finnick Station alludes to the same administrator as well.
  • A section of exposed tracks exist to the east of this station. This is also the first instance of elevated tracks located underground.
  • The Door of Courage is a special souvenir that could only be obtained from this station.

History[]

  • September 14 2016: This station began services.
  • May 29 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[2]
  • May 2 2022: Exit F is added to this station to connect to the Nawis Railway Station of the Same Name.[3]
  • May 7 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[4]

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station takes reference from Lok Fu Station and Ho Man Tin Station of the MTR in Hong Kong, with characteristics of a very long separation between the two platforms from the former and the long staircase to the concourse.

History[]

  • September 7 2015: This station began services.
  • June 29 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • June 14 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • June 28 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

title: World Gazette
safeHtml:
World Gazette, abbreviated as WG, is a Licensed Media Organization in Los Sengas. While the Media and Broadcasting Authority (MBA) had once annoucned that it would discontinue its media license, it was agreed in the 26th Project Nazca conference that this media outlet could continue to operate.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Access
  • 3 Controversies
  • 4 The World Gazette Incident
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

World Gazette is the first privately run Media Outlet in Los Sengas, and mainly operate as an Electronic Media.

  • Address: No.2-8, Coronation Road, Los Sengas
  • Name of Owner: sunnyau
  • License Operating Area: All of Los Sengas
  • License Expiry Date: Until March 28 2017[1]

Access[]

Currently, its headquarter is located at No.2-8, Coronation Road

Controversies[]

Despite releasing news more frequently and having more staff members than Inter-Galactic Media Group (IGMG), the news quality of this media outlet has been put into scrutiny, and misstatements, as well as conflicts arising betwen players and this media group, are not rare. [2]. As a result, the Media and Broadcasting Authority in the Los Sengas Government had announced that its media license would be suspended with immediate effect.[3] However, this announcement was later changed to the discontinuing of its media license, and after the 26th Project Nazca conference, it was agreed that this media outlet could continue to operate.

Woyi Gap Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Festival. Passengers may also use this station to change to Peckern Transit Peckern Line, Metro Line (Woyi Gap Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • The Intus Occident Stabling Sidings is located to the east of this station. It will be expanded in the future to accommodate trains for Xofa Line.
  • This Station was named Kinpriate Place Station at the planning stages, and the Current English Name of this station alludes to the original Chinese Name of this station, which in turn alludes to the Wo Yi Hop area in Tsuen Wan District in Hong Kong.
  • Similar to Intus Occident Gateway, this station also uses Stacked Side Platforms.
  • The Developers of Festival have decided to place signs outside Exit B of this station to pay tribute to two different characters that are foxes in order to allude to the Chinese Name of this station, namely Maho from Princess Connect! Re:Dive and Shirakami Fubuki, a VTuber from Hololive Production.

History[]

  • June 14 2021: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • When Xofa Line was named Xofa Crescent, the Station Number of that line was 5C-04. However, as Xofa Crescent was renamed Xofa Line due to changes in development plans, the Station Number is now 5A-04.[4]
  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Zephyr Line was 11-03. However, due to the construction of Speechless Station and to reserve room for future Centopia development, the Station Number is now 11-04.
  • Stone Slabs are placed around the passageways leading to the exits as this station can be used as a public passage. Even if this station became closed, the Exits could still be used for access from different sides.[5]

History[]

  • July 29 2019: This station began services alongside Xofa Line, but Zephyr Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • August 18 2019: Zephyr Line is established.
  • November 7 2020: The Zephyr Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • May 13 2021: Due to changes in development plans, Xofa Crescent is renamed Xofa Line, and the Station Number of Xofa Line has changed.[7]
  • May 15 2022: Exits A3 and A4 are added to this station.[8]
  • December 25 2022: Due to the construction of Speechless Station and future Centopia development, the Station Number of Zephyr Line has changed.[9]

Description[]

Xofa Line is a branch line of NR Los Sengas Division Stadium Line. It starts at west Peckern, enters east Xofa, before proceeding to the south to Teraleros.

This route is represented by Light Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 5A.

Currently, this route is 10.85 km long, with a total of 6 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S2E11: Intus Occident - Silver Plateau
  • S3E6: Intus Occident - Xofa Bayside
  • S3E14P1: Intus Occident - Xofa Bayside (Line renamed to Xofa Line)
  • S3E19: Intus Occident - Ontario Sound

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Redefine its service plans, become a branch line spurring off Stadium Line instead of interchanging once again with it, and complete renaming to Xofa Line. Completed
(Chapter: S3E14P1)
Extend towards Teraleros at the south of Xofa Bayside Station. Completed
(Chapter: S3E19)

Districts Served[]

  • Peckern
  • Xofa
  • Teraleros

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the Branch Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is a branch of Stadium Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line is the first branch line to begin planning in Los Sengas Division, the first branch line to be established is Sava Line.
  • Original plans of this line involved connecting to Stadium Line at both ends, with the line configuration forming the shape of a crescent (Hence the original English Name of Xofa Crescent) and the original line number being 5C (With C referring to the word "Crescent"). However, due to changes in Xofa development plans, this line has been modified as a branch line radiating from Stadium Line. As a result, the English Name of this line has bee modified to Xofa Line in S3E14 Part 1, and the Line Number has also been modified to 5A.
  • Prior to Zephyr Line and Sparkling Line development in Centopia in Pre-Season 4 Phase 1, this line was the only line providing access to and from Xofa District. Currently, this line is the only line providing access to and from Teraleros.

Yakumo Estate Station was a planned station on Southern Peck Line. It would have been operated by Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu, and would have been located in Los Sengas Peckern. However, due to changes in development plans, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

  • While the plans for Southern Peck Line were scrapped, the section between this station and Nishi-Blu Trove Bay Station became a part of the Peckern South-East Coast Line. The Station corresponding to this station on Peckern South-East Coast Line is Peckern Bay Station. In Fact, the predecessor of Peckern Bay Station is this station, as this station also used the structure that Peckern Bay Station currently uses.
